description: LIST the products this API key tracks (track_product): each with its status, interval, read (offers or product_page), expiry, whether the hot lane has picked it up, the lane's last and next read, plus the plan's tracking allowance (snapshots a day: total, used, remaining). USE WHEN the user asks what is being tracked, whether a tracking is live, how much allowance is left, or wants to stop one (the id goes to DELETE /v1/track/{id} on the REST API). Stopped trackings stay listed for 30 days. COST 0 credits. Paid plans only.

asin.description: Only these products: one ASIN or up to 500 comma-separated (2026-10-30).

country.description: Only this marketplace's trackings (default: every marketplace).

events_for.description: A tracking id: return that tracking's webhook events instead of the list - which notify_if threshold fired on which observation, the payload, and the delivery state (pending / delivered / failed, attempts, last error).

offset.description: Rows to skip (paging; total says how many there are).

status.description: Only trackings in this state (default: all, newest first).

name: list_tracked
